name: A quest drop stack beyond the carry limit still fills the quest (#8076)
contract: Report #8076: on Meat for the Plucked Rook (175334) a Beast Meat drop of 2 cannot be looted when one more is needed.
Quest drops are capped by the item's MaxCount, which for these Pale Reach items equals the quest's required count.
A Scadeald Bear 164039 always drops 2-10 Bear Teeth 560338 for A Tooth for a Song 175324 (50 required, MaxCount 50).
Expected: holding 49 Bear Teeth, looting any such stack takes the one that fits and completes the collection.

steps.label: Fixture: A Tooth for a Song is in progress

Pick up the Bear Teeth stack of at least two
